BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   C. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   D. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Banking as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.

   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

15. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.

   D. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
